stories.headline: What’s the US–China AI ‘hotline’ that Trump plans to pitch to Xi Jinping?
stories.description: Washington and Beijing discuss AI hotline idea amid escalating competition and restrictions on advanced technologies.

stories.headline: Inside Kazakhstan’s push to become a regional AI centre
stories.description: Kazakhstan accelerates AI development but experts warn of impact on the environment and human rights.

stories.headline: British Museum bans visitors from photographing Bayeux Tapestry
stories.description: Visitors stopping to take pictures of the 68m medieval embroidery were holding up others, prompting the rule change.

stories.headline: Moroccan parties mobilise in markets and online for parliamentary elections
stories.description: Moroccan parties are pushing campaigns before the September 23 vote to secure 395 parliamentary seats.

stories.headline: Israeli forces arrest dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank raid
stories.description: At least 53 young men are being held in Biddu after raids left the town in lockdown, with schools and businesses shut.
